reason: An app with my salon's name, WhatsApp bills and a prepaid wallet makes my place look modern next to the other parlours, and I could finally see the takings and the drawer cash without standing at the counter. The first month is free, so I can test it, but I'd make the selfie check-in optional for my staff.
objection: The selfie check-in will make my stylists feel I'm watching them like a factory, and ₹4,999 upfront before I've seen if my team actually uses it is a lot for a 3-chair salon.
would_change_my_mind: If the selfie check-in can't be switched off and the ₹4,999 setup isn't refundable when my staff won't use it, I'd walk away.
